fields.name: Facility/course name
fields.address: Formatted address from source address tags; null if unavailable
fields.osm: OpenStreetMap element type, ID and URL
fields.verification_status: Must not be treated as independently verified unless corroborated

quality_rules: Do not invent missing addresses or postcodes.
Do not silently remove possible duplicates; flag them for review.
Independently check current operating status against the club/operator website before marking active.
Retain source attribution and comply with ODbL share-alike obligations.
